messages:
anika: heads-up — docs CI failing on linkcheck for /getting-started/quickstart. Docusaurus slugify dropped emoji but some cross-page fragment links still include emoji text. example causing CI: /guides#using-the-:sparkles:-feature -> 404 :cry:

matt: saw the logs — about a dozen broken anchors. headings like 'Using the :sparkles: feature' generate slug 'using-the-sparkles-feature' but older markdown links use '#using-the-:sparkles:-feature'. mismatch.

sophie: I can patch the broken links with a small PR. prefer normalizing explicit links to the slugified ascii form rather than editing headings. less churn and keeps canonical titles intact.

tariq: agree. also worth updating Docusaurus slugify options / remark-slug so future files generate stable slugs. we should add a canonical slug section in CONTRIBUTING.md.

matt: quick grep/safe-replace plan (untested):
```bash
# list candidates flagged by CI
git grep -n "#:using-the-" docs/ || true
# safe replace example for a single file
# sed -n '1,200p' docs/guides/using-the-sparkles.md
# git grep -l "#using-the-:sparkles:-feature" docs/ | xargs -n1 -I{} sed -i 's/#using-the-:sparkles:-feature/#using-the-sparkles-feature/g' {}
```

anika: please don't mass-sed without reviews. sophie, open a PR limited to the files CI flagged, with short explanation + test preview. add me as reviewer. :eyes: :thumbsup:

sophie: will do. plan: (1) fix explicit fragment links in only the CI-failed files, (2) normalize a couple of SDK snippets that had CRLF issues (Swift snippet rendering inline), (3) add a tiny pre-linkcheck script that verifies anchor presence and fails fast. I'll include the grep/safe-replace commands in the PR description and a link to the preview deploy.

docs-bot: preview deploy for branch 'sophie/emoji-anchor-fix' is ready — https://deploy-preview-412.docs.redwood-inference.com (expires in 7 days)

matt: FYI I fixed one Swift snippet locally by normalizing fences: replace "```swift\r\n" -> "```swift\n". we should add a docs-lint rule to forbid CRLF inside code fences.

tariq: long-term: add a docs-lint rule to forbid emoji tokens in explicit anchor links and a mapping table in slugify config for common emoji -> word fallbacks. opened internal ticket INFRADOCS-2345 to track.

anika: perfect. assigning @matt and @tariq as reviewers for the PR. sophie — please tag the ticket number in the PR body and leave a short note about the regex and scope so we can revert if it overreaches.

sophie: tagged and pushing the PR in ~10m. i'll kick a preview, run linkcheck locally then open the PR. thanks everyone!
